svg.text: Private cloud storage and collaboration platform running on Amazon EKS
Each service: Deployment + Service + HPA · exposes /health /ready /metrics · JSON logs to stdout
All APIs validate Keycloak JWTs (JWKS) · Prometheus scrapes /metrics
S3 API via IRSA (presign, list, delete)
presigned PUT / GET: file bytes go browser ↔ S3 directly, not through pods
VPC · EKS · RDS · S3 · ECR · IAM
Argo CD pulls the desired state and syncs the cluster
